scorecard.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
scorecard.coaching: Agent never addressed the customer by her verified name 'Hayley' anywhere during the call.

scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Agent failed to acknowledge customer's severe emotional distress and hardship when an unauthorized deduction plunged her into overdraft and left her unable to buy infant medicine.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Agent offered zero restatement of the duplicate payment issue, responding only with technical clearing explanations.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Agent made an insulting and dismissive comment blaming customer's personal budgeting for an overdraft caused by S-Net's duplicate deduction.

grader.scenario: Double Direct Debit billing deduction after card payment; immediate electronic refund initiated; agent never uses customer name, ignores distress over overdraft bank charges, offers zero paraphrasing, and makes rude remark blaming customer budgeting
grader.notes: The agent investigated a duplicate billing deduction of £38.50 that triggered when a scheduled Direct Debit cleared three days after a manual debit card payment, and initiated an immediate BACS electronic refund. However, the agent failed Personalized Call by never addressing the customer by 'Hayley', failed Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement by disregarding Hayley's severe distress when her current account went overdrawn with £45 bank penalties leaving her unable to buy toddler groceries, failed Paraphrasing by offering zero restatement of the billing problem, and failed Build Rapport and Observed Professionalism at minute 8 by rudely blaming her personal budgeting ('If your bank charges you overdraft fees because thirty-eight pounds was debited, that is a personal budgeting issue between you and your bank, not an S-Net problem').

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent never addressed the customer by her name 'Hayley' across any turn in the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: [01:30] Customer: 'Julian, I am a single mother working part-time... My card got declined at the pharmacy this morning when trying to buy infant medicine and milk for my two-year-old daughter! I was reduced to tears of humiliation at the counter!' Agent: 'Automated Direct Debit processing cycles lock payment files three banking days prior to collection dates.' - Complete lack of empathy.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent gave no restatement of customer's duplicate payment problem statement, moving directly to ledger inspection.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: [13:40] Agent correctly reconfirmed the exact amounts (£38.50 refund and £45 goodwill credit) and verified HSBC sort code without redundant re-asking.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: [14:20] Agent: 'I will remain the dedicated owner for this billing dispute and track the Faster Payments release until confirmation is logged.' - Clear personal ownership.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: [05:15] Agent: 'If your bank charges you overdraft fees because thirty-eight pounds was debited, that is a personal budgeting issue between you and your bank, not an S-Net problem.' - Disrespectful and blaming customer remark.
